The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1922–1923''' was contested by 43 teams participating in four divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and western football division of the [[Netherlands]]. [[RCH (football club)|RCH]] won this year's championship by beating [[Be Quick 1887]], [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]], and [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[FC Twente|Enschedese Boys]]
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[LVV Friesland]]
'''Eerste Klasse South:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[FC Eindhoven]]
'''Eerste Klasse West:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[HC & CV Quick]] & [[Sparta Rotterdam]]
